verbose.description: Show live updates of the measurements.

output_file.description: Write the results into the specified FILE.

run_duration.description: Run measurements for N seconds (postfix d/h/m/s). '0s' means run until stopped.

loop_count.description: Run measurements N times then terminate. 0 means run until stopped.

break_latency_us.description: Stop jitterdebugger if latency N or greater is observed.

interval_us.description: Set the sleep time between each measurement in microseconds.

cpu_affinity.description: Set the CPU affinity mask (e.g., '0,2,5-7'). Empty string applies to all CPUs.

priority.description: Set the priority of the measuring threads (1-98).

udp_server.description: Send samples to SERVER:PORT as UDP packets. Empty string disables.

background_command.description: Start workload CMD in background during measurement. Empty string disables.

output_dir.description: Write all samples measured into directory DIR. Empty string disables file output.
